name: Douglas (Isle of Man)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the full coat of arms of Douglas: a shield with a Viking ship, the eagle and child, the lion of Atholl and the Three Legs of Man, with supporters and the motto 'Imperium in Imperio'.
history: The borough arms were granted on 2 March 1896; the blue flag bearing them was in use by 2004 according to council minutes. No formal adoption date is recorded.
